description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 Design, develop, test, and deploy production-quality cyber tools and software capabilities to meet mission-critical customer requirements.

 Apply expertise in vulnerability research, reverse engineering, and exploit development to guide high-level software design decisions.

 Build and maintain operational tooling that supports both defensive and offensive cyber missions.

 Collaborate with researchers, analysts, and stakeholders to translate complex research findings into functional, scalable software.

 Implement proactive feedback mechanisms and iterative development practices to manage and exceed customer expectations.

 Lead code reviews, maintain high coding standards, and ensure software quality through rigorous testing and documentation.

 Synthesize creative technical solutions from diverse operational and technical information sources.

 Identify and communicate operational requirements with internal and external stakeholders to align technical output with mission goals.


 

Required Experience/Clearance
 
 
 3+ years of experience in cyber software development.

 Active Top Secret / SCI security clearance.

 3+ years of experience in contemporary programming languages including C, C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, and Swift.

 3+ years of experience developing cyber tools, exploits, or operational software for offensive or defensive missions.

 3+ years of hands-on experience with reverse engineering tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, OllyDbg, Jeb, Frida, or Windbg.

 3+ years of experience analyzing iOS, Android, Windows, or embedded applications and OS kernel modules.

 Deep understanding of operating system internals, memory management, and low-level systems programming.

 Experience with modern software development practices including version control (Git), CI/CD, and automated testing.

 Strong written and oral communication skills for stakeholder engagement.


 

Desired Experience
 
 We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

 
 Experience with network protocol analysis and static/dynamic malware analysis on mobile platforms (iOS/Android).

 Knowledge of advanced exploit development techniques and mitigation bypass strategies.

 Proficiency in workflow automation, build systems, and specialized toolchain development.

 Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira or Confluence.


 

The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.
 
Redhorse Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.
 
If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting Talent Acquisition at Talent-Acquisition@redhorsecorp.com
 
Redhorse Corporation shall, in its discretion, modify or adjust the position to meet Redhorse’s changing needs. This job description is not a contract and may be adjusted as deemed appropriate in Redhorse’s sole discretion.
